companyDescription: Oncology · ivonescimab (PD-1 x VEGF bispecific) — BLA for EGFR-mutant NSCLC post-TKI under FDA review (PDUFA Nov 14) · five global Phase 3 HARMONi trials · $2B AstraZeneca equity investment at $18.36/share (Oct 2026)
priceNote: Live $14.76 (-4.6%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $12.07-$29.23. Market cap ~$11.8B. Trades ~20% below AstraZeneca's $18.36/share investment price from early October.
summary: Ivonescimab's first FDA decision lands Nov 14 (PDUFA from the official BLA-acceptance PR). HARMONi met PFS but missed OS significance (HR 0.79, p=0.057). That makes this a real two-sided binary, which is why the stock trades ~20% below the price AstraZeneca paid for its $2B stake weeks ago. Consensus $30.23 (+105%; clears the gate). fda_decision has n=3 in core feedback (context only). Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +25% assumes approval and a ~1-2 month re-rating back to the AZ $18.36 reference. This pick's catalyst is 19 days out, just outside the 14d North Star window. แนะนำ 3-5% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Ivonescimab BLA — PDUFA (EGFRm NSCLC post-TKI)
catalysts.description: FDA goal date set in the Jan 2026 BLA-acceptance PR. HARMONi met PFS but OS missed statistical significance (HR 0.79, p=0.057; median 16.8 vs 14.0 months) — the core regulatory question.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: First print since AstraZeneca's $2B convertible-preferred investment.

risks: OS was not statistically significant in HARMONi (HR 0.79, p=0.057) — the FDA may require OS benefit, restrict the label, or issue a CRL.
Good news has not stuck: the +23% AZ pop fully faded within four weeks.
Even on approval, the initial label (EGFRm NSCLC post-TKI) is a niche; the big value sits in the other HARMONi trials still reading out.
Partner dependence: ex-US rights and much of the data come from Akeso; regulatory acceptance of China-heavy data is a recurring FDA question.
Heavy losses (TTM net loss ~$856M) while running five global Phase 3s.

estimateDates.note: First US approval decision for a PD-1xVEGF bispecific

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Large-cap biotech with a $2B AstraZeneca backstop — financing risk is low. Rates matter through the biotech risk appetite into a binary FDA event.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — a big-pharma-validated asset priced below its own strategic investment, into a genuinely two-sided Nov 14 PDUFA. The measured core median at-catalyst return is -6.9% with 74% of picks underwater at their event (n=54), so Entry 2 ($13-14) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

An efficacy-evidence CRL at a biotech with a debated pivotal dataset. HARMONi's non-significant OS is the analogous risk.
